capabilities: Edit .json files in the vault with automatic saving of drafts
Validate JSON and report the line and column of the first error
Format valid JSON with two-space indentation while keeping key order and literals
Search literal matches and jump to first, previous, next or last match
Switch the interface between English and Simplified Chinese
disambiguation: Not a JSON generator or query tool; it only edits, validates, formats and searches .json files stored in the vault.
extras: Free and fully local: no accounts, network requests or telemetry. Any other plugin that already handles .json files must be disabled first. README is bilingual (English and Simplified Chinese).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to edit .json files, so JSON in a vault opens as plain text without validation, formatting or search.
summary: Editor for .json files in a vault that checks syntax, formats with two-space indentation, and searches for matches.
